keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Serhou Guirassy (Borussia Dortmund).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Borussia Dortmund. Konstantinos Karetsas replaces Serhou Guirassy because of an injury.
Julian Ryerson (Borussia Dortmund) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Dani Ceballos (Real Betis).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Natan (Real Betis) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Ramy Bensebaini (Borussia Dortmund) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Borussia Dortmund 0, Real Betis 0.
Second Half begins Borussia Dortmund 0, Real Betis 0.
Goal! Borussia Dortmund 1, Real Betis 0. Fábio Silva (Borussia Dortmund) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Real Betis. Aitor Ruibal replaces Dani Ceballos.
Substitution, Real Betis. Isco replaces Antony.
Valentín Gómez (Real Betis) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Borussia Dortmund 1, Real Betis 1. Aitor Ruibal (Real Betis) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Abde Ezzalzouli.
Substitution, Real Betis. Fran García replaces Valentín Gómez.
Goal! Borussia Dortmund 2, Real Betis 1. Konstantinos Karetsas (Borussia Dortmund) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Fábio Silva.
Substitution, Borussia Dortmund. Maximilian Beier replaces Julian Ryerson.
Substitution, Borussia Dortmund. Joane Gadou replaces Ramy Bensebaini.
Substitution, Borussia Dortmund. Carney Chukwuemeka replaces Felix Nmecha.
Joey Veerman (Borussia Dortmund) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Real Betis. José Antonio Morante replaces Troy Parrott.
Substitution, Real Betis. Marc Roca replaces Facundo Bernal.
Jobe Bellingham (Borussia Dortmund) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Ángel Ortiz (Real Betis) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
